policy.scope: superPC 53 problems only, before WinPC combination
policy.solved: at least 2 of fixed seeds 601,602,603 exact whole-set matches; incomplete stays null
policy.C: correct: actual tree wall through cleanup; failure/timeout:180; interrupted:null; average seeds then problems; all time values reference only
policy.environment: quota/no-space proven interruptions are not results; no retries; no exclusions or extra seeds
policy.load_intervals: external samples cover [utc,utc+60s); high_load_overlap=true if any high interval overlaps; false only with complete coverage; otherwise null (unknown)
policy.time_pairs: same case and seed, same host/contract, actual intervals overlap >=1s, absolute difference of start 1-minute load <=5, both high_load_overlap known and equal, difference of interval-weighted external cpu_pct_other <=200 percentage points; interrupted excluded
policy.time_predictions: B4 and cumulative B5 time comparisons only for eligible concurrent pairs; compute ratio of paired mean C; also report paired-correct actual-time median ratios. Full unmatched means are descriptive only; no final timing support verdict under external load.
policy.B1: N<=60% and BASE>=90%, superPC interim only
policy.B2: report all adjacent solved increments including losses, and difference from N
policy.B5: single G4 (N+4) not run, full B5 pending; no single-arm inference
policy.analysis: freeze policy and reporting source hashes before fresh campaign; retain missed predictions; no commit/push
